scope: Only stimulus, original public-interface contract, observations and fixed historical gates; no engine implementation or algorithm disclosure.

wrapper_operation_contract: Verify the pinned 852176-byte public table input, case_plan and all numeric control values before calling the original.

Build the fixture table view exactly as in the pinned test fixture: 52 waveform rows of 4097 floats; separate 4097-slot sine row with the original helper initialization, and 128 tuning values using the recorded fixture tuning setup. Check the three played notes against their recorded binary32 identities.
Initialize all 150 physical control values from case_plan hex values plus the selected row overrides; do not use any 18-macro or normalized candidate setter.
Construct only FullOracle. Initialize at 44100 Hz, apply the fixture warmup, then note-on/note-off at the exact boundaries. Preserve original processing and controls.
Retain only the original left mono output. Do not render, include, or export historical candidate data.
Write one new monofile plus metadata containing all input identities, case id, parameters as decimal and hex, total and retained frames, output hash, byte count and nonfinite count.

first_identity_check.failure_action: Stop and preserve the mismatch; do not admit the reconstruction or fit/align its output.

first_active_capture_after_identity_chec.identity_limitation: The historical hash authenticates two-column original-plus-old-candidate bytes. A newly captured mono reference cannot be checked against that pair hash. Label it as a new capture from the validated original reconstruction, never as recovered historical PCM.

filter_only.classification: NEW COMPONENT OBSERVATIONS; NOT HISTORICAL PCM RECOVERY OR WHOLE-ENGINE ACCEPTANCE

stimulus.format: mono little-endian IEEE754 binary32; input file supplied to both reference and eventual independent candidate
stimulus.prewarm_parameters: same exact cutoff/resonance as the record

sine_level_observation.generation_rule: For n=0..32767, calculate amplitude*sin(2*pi*2000*n/44100) in binary64 and round once to binary32; generate once, retain the exact input bytes and SHA-256, and reuse those bytes for both outputs.

stimulus.expansion_rule: No larger frequency/resonance/level sweep is authorized by this preparation; choose any next expansion only from the first packet results.

filter_only.measurement_policy: Retain full input/output files. Whole-record and steady-window statistics are labelled separately. No data alignment, output gain adjustment or discarded startup samples in the retained raw capture. These diagnostics explain filter transfer/level dependence; the old dry-voice acceptance thresholds remain unchanged and are not retroactively redefined for this new packet.
filter_only.not_a_missing_byte_recovery: No preexisting impulse/sine/level recording or historical output identity was located in named evidence. The smallest requirement is this new wrapper plus new labelled original-component observations, not guessed old filenames.

failure_preservation.initial_dry: historical_initial_dry_FAIL.json: 18.76–49.37 dB spectral error, fitted gain; not acceptance
failure_preservation.dynamic_range_failure: historical_filter_modulation_range_FAIL.json: accepted 54/72, failed 18 depth1.2 cases, max RMS 5.383274629847556 dB, spectral 8.895468323672016 dB
failure_preservation.failed_dynamic_pcm: Original failed PCM was overwritten by the historical final rerun; not recovered and not to be claimed available.
